title: Backup jobs with retry
pitch: Run a bounded wave, retain its outcomes and retry only unfinished jobs.
makeItYours: Replace the synthetic delay with an operation that returns an archive result only on success.
Set the concurrency limit and maximum attempts for your storage system.
Persist completed archives and retained errors before deciding how to handle unresolved jobs.
useCase: Use it when independent backup jobs need a concurrency limit and a bounded recovery attempt.
